units.source_text: “我早就跟他们说明白了，只要说声你是苗子就行。”

en.t: I already explained it clearly to them. All you have to do is say that you are Naeko.

units.source_text: 千重子搂住苗子的肩膀，领她到后院去，她边走边问：“你吃过饭了吗？”

en.t: Chieko put her arm around Naeko's shoulders and led her to the backyard. As they walked, she asked, "Have you eaten yet?"
